newsitem.title: USA: Pilots association oks labor pact with AMR.
newsitem.headline: Pilots association oks labor pact with AMR.

text.p: The Allied Pilots Association said Wednesday that its board approved a tentative six-year labor pact with AMR Corp's American Airlines.
The board voted 10 to eight for the pact, which goes before the association's 9,150-membership next month for ratification, said association spokesman Gregg Overman.
Separately, American Airlines said it would make a "major company annoucement" on Thursday. The carrier is widely expected to place an order for more than 100 new Boeing jets worth up to $6 billion.
"One of our stated goals was to convince management to invest in the airline, and they appear to be on the verge of doing so, which is good news," Overman said.
The agreement would provide a 3 percent across-the-board pay raise next year, followed two years later by a 2 percent pay increase, Overman said.
It would also grant pilots $3 million in stock options upon the signing, with an additional $2.75 million in stock options granted sometime later, Overman said.
